## 摘要 / Summary

<!-- 对用户或维护者有什么变化？
What changes for users or maintainers? -->

## 范围 / Scope

- [ ] 仅文档 / Documentation only
- [ ] 运行时行为 / Runtime behavior
- [ ] API 或事件契约 / API or event contract
- [ ] 安全或权限 / Security or permissions
- [ ] 依赖或资源锁 / Dependency or resource lock
- [ ] 测试或 CI 覆盖 / Test or CI coverage

## 验证 / Verification

<!-- 列出准确命令和有意义的结果。
List exact commands and meaningful results. -->

- [ ] 文档检查 / `python scripts/check_docs.py`
- [ ] 按需执行 Electron 类型检查、lint、测试和构建 / Electron type-check/lint/tests/build as applicable
- [ ] 按需执行 Python 测试、类型检查和编译检查 / Python tests/type-check/compile checks as applicable
- [ ] 相关时描述服务商、音频、GPU 或虚拟形象的手动验证 / Manual provider, audio, GPU, or avatar validation described when relevant

## 风险与发布说明 / Risk and release notes

<!-- 说明迁移、配置变化、许可证影响、安全影响和已知限制。
Mention migrations, configuration changes, license implications, security impact, and known limitations. -->

## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 未包含密钥、个人数据、日志、数据库、缓存、模型权重或构建产物。 / No secrets, personal data, logs, databases, caches, model weights, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] 新增或变更的契约有回归测试。 / New or changed contracts have regression tests.
- [ ] 第三方资源及许可证已记录。 / Third-party assets and licenses are documented.
- [ ] 文档与实际支持行为一致。 / Documentation matches the actual supported behavior.
